name: Itchy Elephant 78
author: mayurd8862
description: Neon gradient rounded pink button that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.1), box-shadow becomes 0 0 15px #e74784, text color changes from aliceblue to #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Itchy Elephant 78</title>
<style>
/* Itchy Elephant 78 by mayurd8862 — https://uiverse.io/mayurd8862/itchy-elephant-78 */
.button {
  padding: 0.6em 1.3em;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgb(231, 71, 132),
  rgb(0, 170, 255));

  border-radius: 10px;
  border: none;
  color: aliceblue;
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);

  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(55, 0, 255, 0.5);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgb(231, 71, 132);
  color: white;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
